predictive_limitations: Measured95% coverage160/162 is descriptive for correlated targets, not proof of calibrated95% conditional coverage. Report68% coverage and interval width/sharpness; current revised intervals are conservative.
The driver, exposure instrument, model uncertainty and target set differ from the first test, so the old and revised coverage fractions are not a controlled same-target improvement comparison.
Finite correlated nuisance ensemble has weak mixing; the empirical normalization/affine calibration defines a valid predictive algorithm but does not establish a converged physical posterior.

HST exclusions assume the achromatic unattenuated macro flux relation and the retained PSF/centroid/sky/error family; no derived differential extinction/microlensing correction or full Einstein-ring reconstruction is supplied.
